title: Ops Canvas: visual incident storyboard generator with trace clips and PD/Slack attachments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an Ops Canvas feature in Console that auto-generates a visual, editable incident storyboard from traces, logs, and metrics. The core output is a compact timeline canvas that extracts "trace clips" (relevant spans + KV snippets), metric heat slices, and log excerpts and packages them into attachments suitable for PagerDuty and Slack. The canvas should be editable by oncall engineers, support redaction and sampling controls, and export structured sections that autofill postmortems. This ticket covers the backend trace-clip extractor, attachment packaging format, and initial Console surface for sending to PD/Slack.
acceptance_criteria: Backend service extracts trace clips given a trace ID and time window and returns compact JSON with span snippets, top attributes, and example log lines (<= 8KB payload)
Attachment generator builds Slack blocks and PagerDuty attachment payloads that include: thumbnail timeline, 3 prioritized trace clips, top 3 metric anomalies, and direct links to Console canvas

Console shows Ops Canvas UI with ability to: rearrange clips, redact values (mask), edit titles/notes, and press 'Send to PD/Slack' which creates the appropriate attachments and a draft postmortem artifact
Exported postmortem draft populates timeline section with clip timestamps, concise summaries, and TODO checklist items (rollback, mitigate, follow-ups)
Feature respects customer data access controls and KMS-protected fields; redacted values are not present in attachments sent to PD/Slack
E2E test that simulates a high-latency incident (1000 reqs) and verifies generated attachment payload size < 250 KB and send latency < 800ms from Canvas 'Send' click
tasks: Design review: finalize canvas wireframes and Slack/PagerDuty attachment mockups (Figma link in related_links)
Backend: implement trace-clip extractor library with sampling heuristics and privacy redaction hooks
Backend: attachment packager that formats Slack blocks and PD payloads, with size trimming strategies
Console: build Ops Canvas UI stub and integrate edit/save/send flows
Auth: ensure PD/Slack send flow honors org-level secrets and token scoping
QA: create synthetic incident test harness and run E2E tests
Docs: write runbook for oncall usage and add to runbook library
